tokens.name: surface
tokens.usage: Page background — a warm ivory, never pure white, so the gold reads as metal rather than mustard.

tokens.name: surface-raised
tokens.usage: Product cards, drawers, the size picker's options.

tokens.name: gold-soft
tokens.usage: Photo placeholders, the promo strip, selected-row tint. Text on it: `ink` or `gold-deep`.

tokens.name: hairline
tokens.usage: 1px dividers and card borders. Decorative only — never the sole edge of a control.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Headlines and body copy on `surface`, `surface-raised` and `gold-soft` (16:1 light, 15.8:1 dark).

tokens.name: ink-muted
tokens.usage: Secondary copy, captions, strikethrough prices on `surface` and `surface-raised` (≥6.4:1 both themes).

tokens.name: gold
tokens.usage: THE brand gold, sampled from the logo. Marks, 1px rules, outline borders, icons, the selected ring. On light grounds it is 2.8:1 — never small text there; use `gold-deep`.

tokens.name: gold-deep
tokens.usage: Gold you can read: links, eyebrow labels, prices on sale and the primary button fill (5.2:1 on `surface`).

tokens.name: on-gold
tokens.usage: Text and icons on a `gold-deep` fill (5.6:1 light, 8.8:1 dark).

tokens.name: espresso
tokens.usage: The dark hero band and footer — the logo's gold sits best on it.

tokens.name: on-espresso
tokens.usage: Copy on `espresso`. Gold (`gold`) also reads there at 5.7:1.

tokens.name: sale
tokens.usage: Sale price and the Sale tag only, always with the word 'Sale' or a strikethrough beside it (6.3:1 light, 7.4:1 dark).

styles.name: display-xl
styles.usage: One per page: the hero headline.

styles.name: display
styles.usage: Section openers, product name on the product page.

styles.name: title
styles.usage: Product names on cards, category tile names.

styles.name: price
styles.usage: Prices on cards and the product page.

styles.name: label
styles.usage: Eyebrows, nav, buttons, tags — ALWAYS uppercase, echoing the logo's 'BRAVO SHOES' pill.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Icon-to-text gap.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Between tag and name, size options gap.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Card inner padding on mobile.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Card padding, mobile page gutter.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Grid gutter, header height padding.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Desktop page gutter.

tokens.name: space-12
tokens.usage: Between a section title and its content.

tokens.name: space-16
tokens.usage: Between page sections.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Buttons, inputs, size options — crisp, near-square like a shoebox.

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Cards and photos.

tokens.name: radius-pill
tokens.usage: Tags and chips only — the logo's rounded 'BRAVO SHOES' frame.

tokens.name: shadow-lift
tokens.usage: Product card on hover, the bag drawer. Nowhere else.
